prerequisites.description: Experience creating and managing compute, storage, and networking resources in Azure.

recommended_experience: Experience creating and managing compute, storage, and networking resources in Azure. Understanding of networking fundamentals such as name resolution, network protocols, and network address management.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.

retake_policy.notes: After the first failure, wait 24 hours. Wait 14 days between later attempts. At most five attempts in the 12 months starting with the first attempt; after five failures, wait until that period ends. Retake fees apply. See Microsoft's policy for exceptions.

study_actions.detail: Draw a request from an on-premises client to an Azure service. Annotate DNS resolution, routing and network security decisions. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
